derived_from.hypothesis: Every numeric bar is applied before this call, so the picker's only remaining job is interpreting an explicit candidate-specific contradiction in free text. The failure mode is treating the candidate list as a menu and always picking even when the journal says the watch kept recording after the activity ended. Unlike acute injury, this context does not trigger the earlier plan-frame suppression, so the picker is reachable in production.

intent: A database-qualified record is still wrong to announce when the person explicitly says the watch recorded travel after the activity ended. Decline.

fixture.me: 38, works full time, two young kids. Runs three times a week and lifts twice when the week allows. Training for a half marathon in the spring.

candidates.headline: Longest walk in 7 years of tracking — **23.2 km**, past your previous **8.8 km**.

fixture.log:
# Weekly Log

- 2026-09-08 — walked 8.8 km along the coast, then got the bus home. Forgot to stop the watch until I got off, so Health says 23.2 km but the last 14.4 km was the bus, not walking.

judge_assertions.name: declines_without_hedging_into_a_pick
judge_assertions.statement: The response declines and the stated reason refers to the watch continuing to record the bus ride. It does not decline on the grounds that the record is small, that the history is short, or that walking is not what they care about.

notes: The candidate is deliberately impeccable in the database: a seven-year record with a huge margin over hundreds of sessions. The journal is the only place the measurement error exists. Paired with plan_frame_keeps_full_for_a_tracking_error, which proves this same context clears production's earlier gate, and standout_picks_a_decisive_record, which prevents a picker that always declines from passing.
